title: RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair
title_zh: RETRACE：从纠缠的修复历史到可重用的持续集成（CI）修复经验

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE , a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-Repair-Bench , comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem–change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地复用过往经验，但大多数方法都假设问题与解决方案已经对齐。 软件历史很少能提供这种对齐：一个拉取请求（PR）可能包含多个持续集成（CI）问题、失败的尝试、被回滚的编辑以及无关的变更，使得难以判断哪些变更解决了每个问题。 我们提出了 RETRACE——一个从此类历史中重构问题层面修复经验的框架。 RETRACE 结合了一个端点视图，该视图从通过审查的版本中保留的变更反向推理；同时结合了一个开发视图，该视图通过提交历史正向追溯修复过程的演变。 CI 执行证据将这两种视图协调一致，而恢复的经验则以三个抽象层次表示，从具体的修复措施到可迁移的修复模式。 对于新的故障，RETRACE 会检索相关的问题层面经验以指导修复。 在 CI-Repair-Bench 数据集上——该数据集包含来自 101 个仓库、涵盖 12 类故障的 565 个 PR 层面修复——使用 MiniMax-M2.5 时，RETRACE 将 mini-SWE-agent 的 Pass@1 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时则从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%。 在匹配的子集上，Codex 的性能从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%。 结合两种视图始终优于单独使用任一视图，这表明恢复问题与变更的对齐关系，能够使历史 CI 修复成为可复用的修复经验。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly reuse prior solutions, trajectories, and distilled strategies when solving new tasks ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Mu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . These approaches commonly begin with experience already organized around a known task: a known objective paired with a solution, or a trajectory with a clear objective and outcome. Software repositories record far more human problem solving, but not in this clean form. Their logs, commit histories, patches, and validation results arise as part of software development, without an explicit mapping between individual problems and the changes that resolved them.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体在解决新任务时，越来越多地复用先前的解决方案、执行轨迹和提炼出的策略（Ouyang 等，2026；Mu 等，2026；Li 等，2026b）。 这些方法通常以围绕已知任务组织好的经验为起点：即一个已知目标与对应的解决方案，或一条具有明确目标和结果的执行轨迹。 软件仓库记录了远更多的人类问题解决过程，但并非以这种清晰的形式存在。 其中的日志、提交历史、补丁和验证结果都是软件开发过程中产生的，但并未在单个问题与其解决所依赖的变更之间建立明确的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: In collaborative software development, proposed changes are commonly organized as a pull request (PR), which groups one or more commits before they are integrated into a repository. Continuous integration (CI) workflows assess these changes by automatically compiling, testing, and analyzing the repository ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . When CI fails, developers may revise the PR through several commits before the workflow passes. The resulting history records both the observed failures and the human changes that eventually resolved them, making completed PRs a potentially valuable source of repair experience.
paragraphs.zh: 在协作式软件开发中，拟议的变更通常以拉取请求（PR）的形式组织，它将一个或多个提交组合在一起，以便后续合并到代码库中。 持续集成（CI）流程通过自动编译、测试和分析代码库来评估这些变更（Xu et al., 2025）。 当 CI 失败时，开发者可能会通过多次提交修改 PR，直到流程通过为止。 由此产生的历史记录既包含了观察到的失败情况，也包含了最终解决这些问题的人工修改，因此已完成的 PR 可能成为修复经验的重要来源。

paragraphs.en: This experience, however, is difficult to reuse. A PR may contain many commits that address different development tasks, including intermediate repair attempts, reverted changes, and work unrelated to the CI failure. The final patch records the net effect of all these changes, while the passing CI outcome shows only that the PR succeeded as a whole. The history is therefore organized at the PR level, but a repair agent needs guidance for an individual problem. Providing the entire PR adds substantial context without identifying which changes repaired that problem.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种经验很难再次利用。 一个 PR 可能包含许多用于解决不同开发任务的提交，包括中间阶段的修复尝试、已撤销的更改以及与 CI 失败无关的工作。 最终的补丁记录了所有这些更改的净效应，而通过 CI 的结果仅表明整个 PR 是成功的。 因此，历史记录是按 PR 级别组织的，但修复智能体需要针对单个问题获得指导。 提供整个 PR 会增加大量上下文信息，却无法明确哪些更改修复了该问题。

paragraphs.en: This difficulty is not unique to CI. Real-world histories often preserve the actions taken and the final outcome without recording how they are related. In CI repair, this relationship can be inferred from several artifacts. Failure logs and workflow definitions show what CI observed. The commit history shows how potential repairs were introduced and revised, while the endpoint patch shows which changes remained when CI passed. The broader challenge is how to learn from such noisy histories. In CI repair, this requires combining the available artifacts to link each problem to the changes that addressed it and the context in which the repair applies.

paragraphs.en: We introduce RETRACE ( Re pair experience through C hange A ttribution in P ull requests), a framework that reconstructs reusable, problem-level repair experience from entangled PR histories. For each historical PR, RETRACE first organizes the available CI execution evidence and then performs bidirectional change attribution through two views: 1) the endpoint view reasons backward from the changes retained in the passing revision to the CI problems they may address, and 2) the development view follows the commit sequence forward to trace how those changes were introduced, revised, or removed. RETRACE reconciles the two views to infer which developer changes addressed each CI problem and retains only associations supported by the historical artifacts. Each record describes the CI problem and its inferred cause, identifies the developer changes that addressed it and the files or symbols they modified, and retains the CI results and commits supporting the attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RETRACE（通过变更归因重构拉取请求中的修复经验），这是一个能够从相互交织的拉取请求历史中重建可重用、以问题为单位的修复经验的框架。 对于每个历史拉取请求，RETRACE 首先整理可用的持续集成执行证据，然后通过两种视角进行双向变更归因：1）终点视角从通过审查的版本中保留的变更向后追溯，分析这些变更可能解决了哪些持续集成问题；2）开发视角则沿着提交序列向前追踪，追溯这些变更是如何引入、修改或移除的。 RETRACE 将这两种视角进行协调，推断出哪些开发者变更解决了每个持续集成问题，并仅保留有历史证据支持的关联关系。 每条记录描述了持续集成问题及其推断出的原因，识别出解决该问题的开发者变更以及它们修改的文件或符号，并保留了支持该归因的持续集成结果和提交记录。

paragraphs.en: A concrete repair record preserves implementation details, but these details may not transfer when repositories use different files, symbols, dependencies, or code structures. RETRACE therefore represents each repair at three levels of abstraction. The concrete experience preserves the developer changes linked to the problem; the contextual strategy describes how to recognize and repair similar failures; and the transferable pattern generalizes the failure mechanism and repair approach across repositories. For a new CI repair, RETRACE queries all three levels separately for each observed problem. It then filters the retrieved records using the target CI evidence and current repository state before providing them to the repair agent.

As shown in Table 1 , their patches modify, on average, 6.2 × 6.2\times as many files and 7.3 × 7.3\times as many lines as the reference patches in SWE-bench . Moreover, 473 instances (83.7%) contain multiple failure types, increasing the likelihood that a PR-level history contains repair evidence relevant to more than one problem.

sents.en: Moreover, 473 instances (83.7%) contain multiple failure types, increasing the likelihood that a PR-level history contains repair evidence relevant to more than one problem.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RETRACE on CI-Repair-Bench using two repair agents and multiple LLM backbones against two baselines: repair without historical experience ( No-Experience ) and direct reuse of historical repair plans ( Historical-Plan ). With mini-SWE-agent and MiniMax-M2.5, RETRACE reaches 31.9% Pass@1, outperforming No-Experience and Historical-Plan by +12.3 and +13.5 percentage points, respectively. Ablations further show that reconciling the endpoint patch and development history achieves the highest repair success, supporting the use of both views to reconstruct repair experience.

paragraphs.en: Learning from historical repairs. Prior LLM-based repair methods reuse bug–fix examples through retrieval ( Jin et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , reasoning demonstrations ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , stored experiences ( Mu et al., 2026 ) , or reconstructed repair plans ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Although their representations differ, these methods generally assume that historical repairs have already been separated into task-aligned examples, such as an issue paired with a fix, trajectory, or plan. CI histories do not naturally provide this alignment. A failing-to-passing pull request may span multiple commits, address several CI problems, and include intermediate or unrelated changes. RETRACE reconstructs this alignment by combining the endpoint patch, and the commit history to associate individual problems with their supporting repairs. To our knowledge, it is the first approach to reconstruct and reuse problem-level repair experience from multi-commit CI histories.
paragraphs.zh: 从历史修复中学习。 早期的基于大型语言模型的修复方法通过检索（Jin et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023）、推理演示（Yin et al., 2024）、存储的经验（Mu et al., 2026）或重构的修复计划（Yang et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b）来复用错误修复示例。 尽管这些方法的表示形式不同，但它们通常假设历史修复已经被分离为与任务对齐的示例，例如某个问题与对应的修复、执行轨迹或计划配对。 CI 历史记录本身并不会自然地提供这种对齐关系。 一个从失败到通过的拉取请求可能涉及多个提交，解决多个 CI 问题，并包含中间或无关的更改。 RETRACE 通过结合最终补丁和提交历史来重构这种对齐关系，从而将各个问题与其对应的修复关联起来。 据我们所知，这是首个能够从多提交 CI 历史记录中重构并复用问题级修复经验的方法。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level software engineering agents. Repository-level agents combine LLM reasoning with repository exploration, fault localization, code editing, execution, and iterative feedback ( Li et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Antoniades et al., 2025 ) . These systems primarily target SWE-bench-style issue resolution, where a GitHub issue specifies the problem and tests validate the patch. CI repair differs, where one failing workflow may contain multiple CI problems, and early failures hide downstream validation evidence. To evaluate this setting, we use CI-Repair Bench ( Muna et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark of CI repair instances whose changes are substantially larger than those in existing repository-level benchmarks (cf. Table 1 ). RETRACE addresses this challenge by reconstructing problem-level repair records from completed CI repair histories. For a new CI failure, it retrieves relevant records and uses them with the observed CI logs, workflow configuration, and current repository state to guide the repair.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级软件工程智能体。 仓库级智能体将 LLM 推理与仓库探索、故障定位、代码编辑、执行和迭代反馈相结合（Li et al., 2026a；Yang et al., 2024b；Wang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2024；Xia et al., 2024；Antoniades et al., 2025）。 这些系统主要面向 SWE-bench 风格的故障解决，其中 GitHub 问题定义了具体需求，而测试则用于验证修复方案。 CI 修复则有所不同：一个失败的流水线可能包含多个 CI 问题，且早期失败会掩盖下游的验证证据。 为评估这一场景，我们使用了 CI-Repair Bench（Muna et al., 2026），这是一个 CI 修复实例基准，其变更规模远大于现有仓库级基准中的变更（参见表 1）。 RETRACE 通过从已完成的 CI 修复历史中重构问题层面的修复记录，来应对这一挑战。 对于新的 CI 失败，它会检索相关记录，并结合观察到的 CI 日志、流水线配置以及当前仓库状态，以指导修复过程。

paragraphs.en: CI failure understanding and diagnosis. Prior work uses CI execution evidence to identify informative log regions ( Brandt et al., 2020 ) , localize faults across failure types ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Hassan et al., 2023 ) , classify failures ( Aïdasso et al., 2026 ) , and generate diagnoses and repair suggestions ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . These methods focus on failures visible in the current CI execution and do not reconstruct complete multi-problem repair tasks, in which earlier failures may prevent downstream validations from running and leave additional problems unobserved. RETRACE instead reconstructs problem-level repair experience from completed CI histories and uses it to guide a repository-level agent in resolving such problems and making the entire CI workflow succeed.

paragraphs.en: Reusing a completed CI repair requires determining which developer changes addressed each CI problem. RETRACE treats this as a problem–repair attribution task. The available artifacts play different roles in this attribution. The CI logs and workflow definition describe the observed problems and their validation context. The endpoint patch identifies the changes retained in the passing revision, but may also contain unrelated work. The commit history shows how changes were introduced, revised, or removed, but includes intermediate attempts that did not remain in the final repair. RETRACE analyzes the endpoint patch and commit history as complementary views and reconciles them using the CI execution evidence. paragraphs.en: Benchmark and historical repairs. We evaluate RETRACE on CI-Repair-Bench ( Muna et al., 2026 ) , comprising 565 PR-level CI repair instances from 101 repositories and 12 failure categories. Unlike SWE-CI ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , which evaluates long-term maintainability through incremental feature development over 100 tasks, CI-Repair-Bench targets CI failure repair: 83.7% of instances contain multiple concurrent failure types requiring heterogeneous repairs, and related repair evidence recurs within and across repositories. For repositories with multiple instances, the earliest 30% form the historical set, yielding 157 historical repairs and 408 evaluation targets. Appendix A provides further benchmark and split details.

paragraphs.en: Baselines. The No-Experience baseline uses the same configuration settings as RETRACE but receives no historical experience. Directly providing complete PR histories is impractical because their length can exceed the agent’s context window. Hence, we introduce a plan-based baseline, Historical-Plan , which provides the mini-SWE-agent with compact repair plans generated from the same historical repairs following ThinkRepair ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . We choose ThinkRepair because, like RETRACE , it learns from historical bug–fix examples rather than the agent’s own trajectories (e.g., ExpeRepair ( Mu et al., 2026 ) ), so both methods use the same historical repairs. Note that both Historical-Plan and RETRACE use the historical example instances.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 无经验基线方法与 RETRACE 使用相同的配置设置，但不会接收任何历史经验。 直接提供完整的 PR 历史记录并不可行，因为其长度可能超出智能体的上下文窗口限制。 因此，我们引入了一种基于计划的基线方法——Historical-Plan，该方法通过 ThinkRepair（Yin et al., 2024）从相同的历史修复案例中生成简洁的修复计划，并将其提供给 mini-SWE-agent。 我们选择 ThinkRepair，是因为它与 RETRACE 类似，都是从历史错误修复示例中学习，而非智能体自身的执行轨迹（例如 ExpeRepair（Mu et al., 2026）），因此这两种方法都使用相同的历史修复案例。 请注意，Historical-Plan 和 RETRACE 都使用了这些历史示例实例。

paragraphs.en: Performance of RETRACE . RETRACE improves CI repair across both LLM backbones in mini-SWE-agent, raising Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. As shown in Table 2 , these correspond to gains of 12.3 and 9.5 percentage points over No-Experience , respectively; both differences remain significant after Holm correction ( p Holm < 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<0.05 ). Using the same historical repair instances, RETRACE also outperforms Historical-Plan by 13.5 and 14.9 percentage points . In contrast, Historical-Plan performs below No-Experience under both backbones, supporting that problem–repair reconstruction is essential before reuse and using raw experiences adds too much noise to the context. The improvement also extends across repair agents: on the 200-instance subset, RETRACE raises mini-SWE-agent from 23.0% to 27.5% and Codex from 15.5% to 27.5%. These results show that the benefit of problem-level repair experience holds across both evaluated LLM backbones and repair-agent scaffolds.
paragraphs.zh: RETRACE 的性能。 在 mini-SWE-agent 中，RETRACE 提升了两种 LLM 基础模型下的 CI 修复效果：使用 MiniMax-M2.5 时，Pass@1 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%；使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时，则从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%。 如表 2 所示，这些结果分别比 No-Experience 提升了 12.3 和 9.5 个百分点；经过 Holm 校正后，这两个差异仍然显著（p Holm < 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<0.05）。 使用相同的历史修复实例，RETRACE 也比 Historical-Plan 分别高出 13.5 和 14.9 个百分点。 相比之下，Historical-Plan 在两种基础模型下的表现均低于 No-Experience，这表明在复用之前进行问题–修复的重建至关重要，而直接使用原始经验则会向上下文引入过多噪声。 这种改进也体现在不同的修复智能体上：在包含 200 个实例的子集中，RETRACE 将 mini-SWE-agent 的 Pass@1 从 23.0% 提升至 27.5%，并将 Codex 的指标从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%。 这些结果表明，问题层面的修复经验所带来的优势，在两种受评估的 LLM 基础模型和修复智能体框架中均成立。

paragraphs.en: Cost Analysis. With mini-SWE-agent, RETRACE adds a small absolute increase in inference cost but produces substantially better repair results. With MiniMax-M2.5, the average cost increases by $0.059 per instance, from $0.080 to $0.139, while Pass@1 improves by 12.3 percentage points . With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the cost increases by $0.019, from $0.033 to $0.052, alongside a 9.5-point improvement . With Codex, RETRACE improves Pass@1 while also reducing cost from $0.142 to $0.118 per instance. Its average input usage decreases from 3.13M to 2.21M tokens, consistent with the retrieved experience helping limit unnecessary exploration. Note that these are end-to-end costs that include memory retrieval, reuse, and the agent’s planning and execution.

paragraphs.en: Ablation Studies. Both reconstruction views and higher abstraction levels contribute to RETRACE ’s repair performance. The full reconstruction reaches 31.9%, 32.8%, and 27.5% Pass@1, outperforming both single-view variants , as shown in Table 3 . Removing either the endpoint or development view lowers Pass@1, with the full method exceeding the stronger single-view variant by 3.5, 4.4, and 2.0 percentage points, respectively. Table 4 shows a similar progression across abstraction levels: Pass@1 increases from 26.0% with L1 to 28.0% with L1+L2 and 30.5% with L1+L2+L3 , for a total gain of 4.5 points over L1. We conduct the abstraction-level ablation with mini-SWE-agent and DeepSeek-V4-Flash rather than Codex because Codex is more expensive to evaluate and provides a less favorable cost-performance setting for additional ablation runs.
paragraphs.zh: 消融研究。 重建视图和更高层级的抽象都对 RETRACE 的修复性能有所贡献。 完整重建的 Pass@1 达到 31.9%、32.8% 和 27.5%，优于两种单视图变体，如表 3 所示。 移除端点视图或开发视图中的任何一种都会降低 Pass@1，而完整方法分别比性能更强的单视图变体高出 3.5、4.4 和 2.0 个百分点。 表 4 显示了不同抽象层级之间的类似趋势：Pass@1 从 L1 的 26.0% 增加到 L1+L2 的 28.0%，再到 L1+L2+L3 的 30.5%，相比 L1 总共提升了 4.5 个百分点。 我们使用 mini-SWE-agent 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 而非 Codex 进行抽象层级的消融研究，因为 Codex 的评估成本更高，且在进行额外消融运行时成本效益较低。

paragraphs.en: RETRACE has three main limitations. First, intermediate development history may be incomplete or unavailable, restricting reconstruction to the evidence preserved in the endpoint repair. Second, some repair histories span multiple problems and substantial execution and change context, making LLM-based attribution and filtering more challenging. Third, validating each repair through the complete CI workflow would provide stronger feedback before proceeding to subsequent problems, but repeatedly executing these workflows is computationally and time intensive. Moreover, CI workflows often depend on custom actions, services, configurations, and environments that are difficult to reproduce locally. RETRACE therefore relies on lightweight local validation when feasible rather than full CI execution after each repair step.
paragraphs.zh: RETRACE 存在三个主要局限性。 首先，中间的开发历史可能不完整或无法获取，因此重构工作仅限于在最终修复中保留的证据。 其次，某些修复历史涉及多个问题以及大量的执行和上下文变更，这使得基于 LLM 的归因和筛选变得更加困难。 第三，通过完整的 CI 工作流程验证每次修复，可以在进入后续问题之前提供更强的反馈，但重复执行这些工作流程在计算和时间上都非常耗费资源。 此外，CI 工作流程通常依赖于自定义操作、服务、配置和环境，而这些内容很难在本地重现。 因此，在可行的情况下，RETRACE 更倾向于采用轻量级的本地验证，而不是在每次修复步骤后执行完整的 CI 流程。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced RETRACE , a framework for reconstructing reusable problem-level repair experience from entangled CI repair histories. RETRACE performs bidirectional change attribution by reasoning backward from endpoint patches and forward through development histories, using organized CI evidence to associate developer changes with individual CI problems. It represents each resulting problem-repair experience at three abstraction levels that guide the repair of new CI failures. We evaluated RETRACE on the CI-Repair-Bench, where it consistently outperformed the studied baselines across multiple LLM backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 RETRACE——一个用于从相互交织的持续集成（CI）修复历史中重建可重用问题级修复经验的框架。 RETRACE 通过从最终补丁反向推理、沿开发历史正向追溯的方式执行双向变更归因，并利用结构化的 CI 证据将开发者的变更与具体的 CI 问题关联起来。 它将每个生成的问题-修复经验表示为三个抽象层次，用于指导新 CI 故障的修复。 我们在 CI-Repair-Bench 上对 RETRACE 进行了评估，结果表明，它在多种大型语言模型（LLM）基础上均持续优于所研究的基线方法。

paragraphs.en: We measure repair recurrence to quantify the extent to which CI-Repair-Bench contains related repair experience. We consider two complementary views. Structural similarity measures overlap in normalized CI and repair attributes, including failure types, validation commands, dependencies, and modified files, using mean Jaccard similarity. Lexical similarity represents failure, workflow, and repair evidence using TF–IDF unigram and bigram features and measures their cosine similarity.

paragraphs.en: During offline reconstruction, RETRACE infers dependency relations among problems within each historical repair. A relation p i → p j p_{i}\rightarrow p_{j} indicates that the available repair evidence supports resolving p i p_{i} before p j p_{j} . The resulting dependency graph is topologically ordered so that prerequisite repairs precede the problems that depend on them. These relations preserve the structure and repair order of historical multi-problem episodes and can provide evidence about problems that may not yet be visible in the target CI execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在离线重构过程中，RETRACE 会推断每次历史修复中各个问题之间的依赖关系。 关系 p i → p j p_{i}\rightarrow p_{j} 表示可用的修复证据支持先解决 p i p_{i}，再解决 p j p_{j}。 由此生成的依赖图具有拓扑顺序，确保前提修复先于依赖它们的问题进行。 这些关系保留了历史多问题事件的结构和修复顺序，并能为目标 CI 执行中可能尚未显现的问题提供证据。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the problems directly observed in the target CI failure, RETRACE uses the retrieved L1 and L2 experience to identify problem patterns that recur in historical repairs from the same repository and workflow. RETRACE examines the reconstructed problems across these instances and groups similar problems to estimate their recurrence within the corresponding repository–workflow scope. A problem pattern is considered recurring when it appears in at least 50% of the relevant historical instances. Recurring patterns that are not already represented in the target problem set are retained as candidate problems for the current repair. Because these problems are inferred from historical recurrence rather than directly observed in the current CI execution, they are treated as historically supported repair hypotheses and are subsequently consolidated with the observed problems.
paragraphs.zh: 除了目标CI故障中直接观察到的问题外，RETRACE还利用检索到的L1和L2经验，识别出在相同代码库和工作流的历史修复中重复出现的问题模式。 对于每个目标问题，适用的L1和L2记录会识别出相关的历史修复实例。 RETRACE会检查这些实例中重构出的问题，并将相似的问题进行分组，以估算它们在对应代码库-工作流范围内的重复出现概率。 当某个问题模式在至少50%的相关历史实例中出现时，该模式被视为重复出现的模式。 那些尚未体现在目标问题集中的重复模式，会被保留为当前修复的候选问题。 由于这些问题是根据历史重复性推断出来的，而非在当前CI执行中直接观察到的，因此它们被视作有历史依据的修复假设，并最终与已观察到的问题合并处理。

paragraphs.en: To identify recurring problems across historical repairs, RETRACE groups similar reconstructed problems using a weighted similarity score over the problem description, root cause, affected files, failure type, repair strategy, and file-type compatibility:

paragraphs.en: Problem-description similarity receives the largest weight, while root-cause and affected-file similarity provide additional evidence that two records represent the same or a closely related problem. Failure type, repair strategy, and file-type compatibility provide supporting signals. Problems with S ⁡ ( p i , p j ) ≥ 0.50 S(p_{i},p_{j})\geq 0.50 are assigned to the same cluster. A cluster is considered recurring when it appears in at least 50% of the historical issues within the corresponding repository–workflow scope. The clustering threshold is specific to historical problem grouping and is independent of the cosine-similarity retrieval described in Appendix B.1.3 .

paragraphs.en: The resulting problems are processed sequentially in the same working tree. Each problem is handled through a fresh agent interaction, while modifications made for earlier problems remain in the repository and are therefore visible to subsequent interactions. Where feasible, the agent may execute the problem-specific validation command and use its output to refine the current repair. Such execution feedback is used within the current repair interaction and does not automatically introduce a new problem into the planned repair sequence.

paragraphs.en: Endpoint reconstruction is performed offline on historical successful repairs used to construct repair experience. Given the observed CI failure, the completed developer patch, and the CI workflow context, RETRACE reconstructs the atomic problems addressed by the repair through three stages: validation-step classification, atomic-problem extraction, and problem consolidation. This process is applied only to historical repair instances; ground-truth patches from evaluation instances are never used. The following templates show the prompts used at each stage, with placeholders in braces replaced by instance-specific evidence at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 端点重建在离线状态下对用于构建修复经验的历史成功修复案例执行。 基于观察到的 CI 故障、已完成的开发者补丁以及 CI 工作流上下文，RETRACE 通过三个阶段重建修复所解决的原子问题：验证步骤分类、原子问题提取和问题整合。 此过程仅应用于历史修复实例；评估实例中的真实补丁绝不会被使用。 以下模板展示了各阶段使用的提示词，其中花括号内的占位符会在运行时替换为具体实例的证据。

paragraphs.en: Development-history reconstruction is performed offline on historical successful repairs used to construct repair experience. It analyzes the development trajectory from the failing revision to the successful revision to recover how CI-relevant problems and repairs evolve across intermediate developer changes. The following templates provide the prompts used at each stage, with placeholders in braces replaced by instance-specific evidence at runtime.

paragraphs.zh: 对于历史轨迹中的每次提交，第一阶段会识别出那些修改直接或间接影响 CI 验证的文件。

paragraphs.en: The selected changes are analyzed in trajectory order to identify the CI-relevant events associated with each commit. The prompt distinguishes problems that are introduced, repaired, replaced, or supported by the commit while grounding each event in the observed repository changes.

paragraphs.en: For each candidate cluster, RETRACE compares the problem–repair records reconstructed from the development and endpoint views and determines whether they represent the same problem, provide complementary evidence, conflict, or correspond to distinct repair problems.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选簇，RETRACE 会对比从开发和终点视角重构的问题-修复记录，并判断这些记录是否代表同一问题、提供互补证据、存在冲突，或对应不同的修复问题。

paragraphs.en: For SELECT , the selected source record is retained directly. For SEPARATE , the source records remain independent. Only groups assigned MERGE require an additional synthesis step. If a source record is omitted from the adjudication output, it is conservatively retained as a separate problem.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 SELECT，选定的源记录会直接保留。 对于 SEPARATE，源记录保持独立。 只有分配了 MERGE 的组需要额外的合成步骤。 如果某个源记录未被包含在裁决输出中，则会谨慎地将其作为独立问题保留。

sents.en: For SELECT , the selected source record is retained directly.

paragraphs.en: When development-view and endpoint-view records describe the same atomic problem but provide complementary evidence, RETRACE synthesizes them into a single problem record. The synthesis preserves the repair operations and concrete evidence from both views rather than generating a new repair hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 当开发视图和端点视图的记录描述了同一个原子问题，但提供了互补的证据时，RETRACE 会将它们综合为一个单一的问题记录。 这种综合保留了两种视图中的修复操作和具体证据，而不是生成一个新的修复假设。

paragraphs.en: The synthesized record retains its source identifiers as provenance. If synthesis fails or produces unsupported content, the original source records are retained rather than constructing a new problem.
paragraphs.zh: 合成的记录保留了其来源标识符作为来源信息。 如果合成失败或生成不支持的内容，则保留原始源记录，而不是构建新问题。

paragraphs.en: Cross-view adjudication operates on individual candidate clusters, so duplicate or unsupported records may remain across clusters. RETRACE therefore reviews the reconciled problem set jointly to retain CI-relevant problems, remove unsupported records, and consolidate remaining global duplicates.

paragraphs.en: The retained records form the reconciled historical problem set. Each record preserves its provenance as development-view-only, endpoint-view-only, or supported by both reconstruction views.
paragraphs.zh: 保留下来的记录构成了经过核对的历史问题集。 每条记录都保留了其来源信息，显示为仅开发视图、仅端点视图，或由两种重建视图共同支持。

paragraphs.en: The L2 prompt transforms the organized concrete repair records (L1) into contextual repair strategies. It groups related problems and summarizes how they can be diagnosed, repaired, and validated while preserving relevant dependency and repair-order information.
paragraphs.zh: L2 提示将结构化的混凝土修复记录（L1）转化为情境化的修复策略。 它能对相关问题进行分组，并总结如何诊断、修复和验证这些问题，同时保留相关的依赖关系和修复顺序信息。

paragraphs.en: mini-SWE-Agent interacts with the repository through shell commands. paragraphs.en: We adapt ThinkRepair ( Yin et al., 2024 ) as an experience-based baseline. Following ThinkRepair, we construct a knowledge pool from historical repair instances and retrieve relevant knowledge as chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations for the target problem. The model uses these demonstrations to reason about the target failure and produce a step-by-step repair plan. We then provide this plan to mini-SWE-Agent, which applies the repair to the target repository and generates the final patch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 ThinkRepair（Yin 等人，2024）作为基于经验的基线方法。 遵循 ThinkRepair 的方法，我们从历史修复实例中构建一个知识库，并检索相关知识作为目标问题的思维链（CoT）演示。 模型利用这些演示来推理目标故障，并生成逐步的修复计划。 随后，我们将该计划提供给 mini-SWE-Agent，由其将修复方案应用于目标代码库并生成最终的补丁。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 examines the overlap among instances resolved by the endpoint, development, and full reconstruction strategies with mini-SWE-agent. With MiniMax-M2.5, at least one strategy resolves 146 of the 408 evaluation instances (35.8%), including 90 resolved by all three configurations; the full configuration uniquely resolves 12 instances. Similarly, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, at least one strategy resolves 144 instances (35.3%), including 99 resolved by all three configurations; the full configuration uniquely resolves 17 instances. These unique successes, together with the substantial overlap across configurations, show that the endpoint and development reconstruction views provide complementary repair information. This provides an instance-level view of the reconstruction ablation in Table 3 , complementing the aggregate Pass@1 results.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 研究了通过端点、开发以及完整重建策略与 mini-SWE-agent 解决的实例之间的重叠情况。 使用 MiniMax-M2.5 时，至少有一种策略能够解决 408 个评估实例中的 146 个（35.8%），其中包括所有三种配置都能解决的 90 个实例；完整配置单独解决了 12 个实例。 同样地，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时，至少有一种策略能够解决 144 个实例（35.3%），其中包括所有三种配置都能解决的 99 个实例；完整配置单独解决了 17 个实例。 这些独特的成功案例，加上各配置之间显著的重叠，表明端点和开发重建视角提供了互补的修复信息。 这为表 3 中的重建消融分析提供了实例层面的视角，从而补充了汇总的 Pass@1 结果。
